WITH
scoped_repos AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT pm.row_id AS repo_id
  FROM project_mapping pm
  WHERE pm.`table` = 'repos' AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project))
),
merged AS (
  SELECT pr.id
  FROM pull_requests pr
  WHERE pr.base_repo_id IN (SELECT repo_id FROM scoped_repos)
    AND pr.merged_date >= NOW() - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND pr.merged_date < NOW()
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS n_prs FROM merged

  SELECT DISTINCT CASE WHEN pr.author_id LIKE 'github:GithubAccount:%' THEN CONCAT('gh:', SUBSTRING_INDEX(pr.author_id, ':', -1)) ELSE pr.author_id END AS author_key

  JOIN gh_emails ge ON ge.author_email = a.user_email
  WHERE a.record_kind = 'canonical_activity' AND a.user_email <> ''
    AND a.source_connection_id IN (SELECT connection_id FROM otel_conns)
    AND a.date > DATE(NOW() - INTERVAL 7 DAY)
)
SELECT CONCAT(COALESCE(ROUND(100 * (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_users WHERE author_key IN (SELECT author_key FROM authors)) / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM authors), 0)), 0), '%') AS n_adopt

WITH
project_repos AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT pm.project_name, pm.row_id AS repo_id
  FROM project_mapping pm
  WHERE pm.`table` = 'repos' AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project))

),

  FROM project_mapping pm
  WHERE pm.`table` = 'cicd_scopes' AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project))
),
scoped_cicd AS (

  FROM project_mapping pm
  WHERE pm.`table` = 'cicd_scopes' AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project))
),
prod_deploys AS (
  SELECT dc.cicd_scope_id AS scope_id, LOWER(dc.environment) AS env, dc.cicd_deployment_id AS id,
    MIN(dc.repo_id) AS repo_id, MIN(dc.finished_date) AS ts, MIN(dc.commit_sha) AS sha, MIN(dc.name) AS name, MIN(dc.url) AS url, MAX(dc.result IN ('FAILURE', 'FAILED')) AS failed
  FROM cicd_deployment_commits dc
  WHERE dc.cicd_scope_id IN (SELECT scope_id FROM scoped_cicd)
    AND dc.result IN ('SUCCESS', 'FAILURE', 'FAILED') AND LOWER(dc.environment) LIKE '%prod%'
    AND dc.finished_date < NOW()
  GROUP BY dc.cicd_scope_id, LOWER(dc.environment), dc.cicd_deployment_id
),
issue_base AS (
  SELECT pb.project_name, pb.board_id, i.id, i.issue_key, i.title, i.url, i.priority, i.type, i.status, i.original_status,
    i.assignee_id, i.assignee_name, i.created_date, i.id LIKE 'jira:%' AS is_jira,
    COALESCE(i.updated_date, i.created_date) AS last_activity, i.updated_date
  FROM project_boards pb
  JOIN board_issues bi ON bi.board_id = pb.board_id
  JOIN issues i ON i.id = bi.issue_id
  WHERE i.status <> 'DONE' AND COALESCE(i.type, '') <> 'EPIC'
    AND COALESCE(i.original_status, '') NOT IN ('Closed', 'Cancelled', 'Invalid')
    AND COALESCE(i.updated_date, i.created_date) >= NOW() - INTERVAL 90 DAY
),
status_now AS (
  SELECT h.issue_id, MAX(h.start_date) AS since
  FROM issue_status_history h
  WHERE h.is_current_status = 1 AND h.issue_id IN (SELECT id FROM issue_base)
  GROUP BY h.issue_id
),
first_progress AS (
  SELECT h.issue_id, MIN(h.start_date) AS started
  FROM issue_status_history h
  WHERE h.status = 'IN_PROGRESS' AND h.issue_id IN (SELECT id FROM issue_base)
  GROUP BY h.issue_id
),
open_issues AS (
  SELECT ib.project_name, ib.board_id, ib.id, ib.issue_key, ib.title, ib.url, ib.priority, ib.type, ib.status, ib.original_status,
    ib.assignee_id, ib.assignee_name, ib.created_date, ib.is_jira, ib.last_activity,
    COALESCE(sn.since, ib.updated_date, ib.created_date) AS status_since
  FROM issue_base ib
  LEFT JOIN status_now sn ON sn.issue_id = ib.id
)
, merged_90 AS (
  SELECT pr.id, pr.base_repo_id AS repo_id, TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, pr.created_date, pr.merged_date) AS merge_min
  FROM pull_requests pr
  WHERE pr.base_repo_id IN (SELECT repo_id FROM project_repos)
    AND pr.merged_date >= NOW() - INTERVAL 90 DAY AND pr.merged_date < NOW()
),
repo_med AS (
  SELECT repo_id,
    MAX(CASE WHEN kind = 'merge' AND rn = CEIL(0.5 * n) THEN v END) AS merge_median,
    MAX(CASE WHEN kind = 'pickup' AND rn = CEIL(0.5 * n) THEN v END) AS pickup_median
  FROM (
    SELECT repo_id, kind, v,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY repo_id, kind ORDER BY v) AS rn,
      COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY repo_id, kind) AS n
    FROM (
      SELECT repo_id, 'merge' AS kind, merge_min AS v FROM merged_90
      UNION ALL
      SELECT m.repo_id, 'pickup', MIN(ppm.pr_pickup_time)
      FROM merged_90 m
      JOIN project_pr_metrics ppm ON ppm.id = m.id
      WHERE ppm.pr_pickup_time IS NOT NULL
      GROUP BY m.id, m.repo_id
    ) vals
  ) ranked
  GROUP BY repo_id
),
open_prs_all AS (
  SELECT pr.id, pr.base_repo_id AS repo_id, pp.project_name, CONCAT('#', pr.pull_request_key) AS item, pr.title, pr.url,
    pr.created_date, TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, pr.created_date, NOW()) AS age_min,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(a.full_name, ''), NULLIF(a.user_name, ''), pr.author_name) AS owner
  FROM pull_requests pr
  JOIN project_repos pp ON pp.repo_id = pr.base_repo_id
  LEFT JOIN accounts a ON a.id = pr.author_id
  WHERE pr.status = 'OPEN' AND COALESCE(pr.is_draft, 0) = 0 AND pr.created_date < NOW()
),
pr_comment_last AS (
  SELECT c.pull_request_id, MAX(c.created_date) AS last_at
  FROM pull_request_comments c
  WHERE c.pull_request_id IN (SELECT id FROM open_prs_all)
  GROUP BY c.pull_request_id
),
pr_commit_last AS (
  SELECT prc.pull_request_id, MAX(prc.commit_authored_date) AS last_at
  FROM pull_request_commits prc
  WHERE prc.pull_request_id IN (SELECT id FROM open_prs_all)
  GROUP BY prc.pull_request_id
),
open_prs AS (
  SELECT x.id, x.repo_id, x.project_name, x.item, x.title, x.url, x.created_date, x.age_min, x.owner, x.last_activity
  FROM (
    SELECT op.id, op.repo_id, op.project_name, op.item, op.title, op.url, op.created_date, op.age_min, op.owner,
      GREATEST(op.created_date, COALESCE(cl.last_at, op.created_date), COALESCE(kl.last_at, op.created_date)) AS last_activity
    FROM open_prs_all op
    LEFT JOIN pr_comment_last cl ON cl.pull_request_id = op.id
    LEFT JOIN pr_commit_last kl ON kl.pull_request_id = op.id
  ) x
  WHERE x.age_min >= 0 AND x.last_activity >= NOW() - INTERVAL 90 DAY
),
stale_prs AS (
  SELECT op.id, op.project_name, op.item, op.title, op.url, op.owner, op.age_min, op.last_activity
  FROM open_prs op
  LEFT JOIN repo_med rm ON rm.repo_id = op.repo_id
  WHERE op.age_min > COALESCE(2 * rm.merge_median, 14 * 1440)
),
waiting_reviews AS (
  SELECT op.id, op.project_name, op.item, op.title, op.url, op.age_min, op.last_activity,
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT COALESCE(NULLIF(prr.name, ''), prr.user_name) ORDER BY COALESCE(NULLIF(prr.name, ''), prr.user_name) SEPARATOR ', ') AS reviewers
  FROM open_prs op
  JOIN pull_request_reviewers prr ON prr.pull_request_id = op.id
  WHERE op.age_min > 2 * 1440
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM pull_request_comments c
      WHERE c.pull_request_id = op.id AND c.account_id = prr.reviewer_id AND c.type IN ('REVIEW', 'DIFF'))
  GROUP BY op.id, op.project_name, op.item, op.title, op.url, op.age_min, op.last_activity
),
resolved_90 AS (
  SELECT i.id, bi.board_id, i.resolution_date
  FROM issues i
  JOIN board_issues bi ON bi.issue_id = i.id
  WHERE bi.board_id IN (SELECT board_id FROM project_boards)
    AND i.resolution_date >= NOW() - INTERVAL 90 DAY AND i.resolution_date < NOW()
    AND COALESCE(i.type, '') <> 'EPIC' AND COALESCE(i.original_status, '') NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Invalid')
),
resolved_start AS (
  SELECT h.issue_id, MIN(h.start_date) AS started
  FROM issue_status_history h
  WHERE h.status = 'IN_PROGRESS' AND h.issue_id IN (SELECT id FROM resolved_90)
  GROUP BY h.issue_id
),
board_med AS (
  SELECT board_id, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = CEIL(0.5 * n) THEN days END) AS median_days
  FROM (
    SELECT r.board_id, TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, rs.started, r.resolution_date) / 1440 AS days,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.board_id ORDER BY TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, rs.started, r.resolution_date)) AS rn,
      COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY r.board_id) AS n
    FROM resolved_90 r
    JOIN resolved_start rs ON rs.issue_id = r.id
  ) ranked
  GROUP BY board_id
),
stalled AS (
  SELECT oi.project_name, oi.id, oi.issue_key, oi.title, oi.url, oi.assignee_name, oi.last_activity,
    TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, COALESCE(fp.started, oi.status_since), NOW()) / 24 AS days_in_progress,
    COALESCE(2 * bm.median_days, 14) AS threshold_days
  FROM open_issues oi
  LEFT JOIN first_progress fp ON fp.issue_id = oi.id
  LEFT JOIN board_med bm ON bm.board_id = oi.board_id
  WHERE oi.is_jira AND CASE WHEN oi.original_status = 'Closed' THEN 'DONE' WHEN oi.original_status IN ('To Do', 'To do', 'Todo') THEN 'TODO' WHEN oi.original_status = 'Ready for Development' THEN 'TODO' WHEN oi.id NOT LIKE 'jira:%' AND oi.status <> 'DONE' THEN CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pull_request_issues pri JOIN pull_requests p2 ON p2.id = pri.pull_request_id AND p2.status = 'OPEN' WHERE pri.issue_id = oi.id) THEN 'IN_PROGRESS' WHEN COALESCE(oi.assignee_id, '') <> '' THEN 'IN_PROGRESS' ELSE 'TODO' END ELSE oi.status END = 'IN_PROGRESS' AND NOT oi.original_status IN ('Blocked', 'Tech Block', 'Business Block')
),
multi_sprint AS (
  SELECT si.issue_id, COUNT(DISTINCT si.sprint_id) AS sprints, MIN(s.started_date) AS first_start
  FROM sprint_issues si
  JOIN sprints s ON s.id = si.sprint_id
  GROUP BY si.issue_id
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT si.sprint_id) >= 2
),
scope_added AS (
  SELECT ic.issue_id, MAX(ic.created_date) AS added_at
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM open_issues WHERE is_jira) oj
  JOIN issue_changelogs ic ON ic.issue_id = oj.id AND ic.field_name = 'Sprint'
  JOIN sprints s ON s.status = 'ACTIVE' AND FIND_IN_SET(s.id, ic.original_to_value) AND NOT FIND_IN_SET(s.id, COALESCE(ic.original_from_value, ''))
  WHERE ic.created_date > s.started_date AND (s.completed_date IS NULL OR ic.created_date < s.completed_date)
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM sprints p
      WHERE FIND_IN_SET(p.id, COALESCE(ic.original_from_value, ''))
        AND p.completed_date BETWEEN ic.created_date - INTERVAL 1 HOUR AND ic.created_date + INTERVAL 1 HOUR)
  GROUP BY ic.issue_id
),
latest_deploy AS (
  SELECT scope_id, env, sha, url, ts, failed, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY scope_id, env ORDER BY ts DESC) AS rn
  FROM prod_deploys
),
att_raw AS (
  SELECT 'High' AS severity, 2 AS severity_rank, 'Unapproved PR' AS category, 2 AS cat_rank, op.item, op.title,
    CONCAT('Open ', FLOOR(op.age_min / 1440), 'd, no approving review') AS reason, FLOOR(op.age_min / 1440) AS age_days,
    op.project_name, op.owner, op.url, CONCAT('pr:', op.id) AS ref, op.last_activity
  FROM open_prs op
  LEFT JOIN repo_med rm ON rm.repo_id = op.repo_id
  WHERE op.age_min > COALESCE(rm.pickup_median, 2 * 1440)
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pull_request_comments c WHERE c.pull_request_id = op.id AND c.status = 'APPROVED')
  UNION ALL
  SELECT CASE WHEN sp.age_min > 30 * 1440 AND sp.last_activity < NOW() - INTERVAL 30 DAY THEN 'Low' ELSE 'High' END,
    CASE WHEN sp.age_min > 30 * 1440 AND sp.last_activity < NOW() - INTERVAL 30 DAY THEN 4 ELSE 2 END,
    'Stale PR', 3, sp.item, sp.title,
    CASE WHEN sp.age_min > 30 * 1440 AND sp.last_activity < NOW() - INTERVAL 30 DAY
      THEN CONCAT('Open ', FLOOR(sp.age_min / 1440), 'd, no activity for ', TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, sp.last_activity, NOW()), 'd')
      ELSE CONCAT('Open ', FLOOR(sp.age_min / 1440), 'd, past twice the repo median to merge') END,
    FLOOR(sp.age_min / 1440), sp.project_name, sp.owner, sp.url, CONCAT('pr:', sp.id), sp.last_activity
  FROM stale_prs sp
  UNION ALL
  SELECT CASE WHEN wr.age_min > 3 * 1440 THEN 'High' ELSE 'Medium' END, CASE WHEN wr.age_min > 3 * 1440 THEN 2 ELSE 3 END,
    'Review waiting', 1, wr.item, wr.title, CONCAT('Open ', FLOOR(wr.age_min / 1440), 'd, requested reviewer has not reviewed'),
    FLOOR(wr.age_min / 1440), wr.project_name, wr.reviewers, wr.url, CONCAT('pr:', wr.id), wr.last_activity
  FROM waiting_reviews wr
  UNION ALL
  SELECT CASE WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, oi.status_since, NOW()) > 7 * 24 THEN 'Critical' ELSE 'High' END,
    CASE WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, oi.status_since, NOW()) > 7 * 24 THEN 1 ELSE 2 END,
    'Blocked ticket', 4, oi.issue_key, oi.title,
    CONCAT(oi.original_status, ' for ', GREATEST(TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, oi.status_since, NOW()), 0), 'd'),
    GREATEST(TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, oi.status_since, NOW()), 0), oi.project_name, NULLIF(oi.assignee_name, ''), oi.url, CONCAT('issue:', oi.id), oi.last_activity
  FROM open_issues oi
  WHERE oi.is_jira AND oi.original_status IN ('Blocked', 'Tech Block', 'Business Block')
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'High', 2, 'Stalled ticket', 5, st.issue_key, st.title,
    CONCAT('In progress ', FLOOR(st.days_in_progress), 'd, limit ', FLOOR(st.threshold_days), 'd'),
    FLOOR(st.days_in_progress), st.project_name, NULLIF(st.assignee_name, ''), st.url, CONCAT('issue:', st.id), st.last_activity
  FROM stalled st
  WHERE st.days_in_progress > st.threshold_days
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Medium', 3, 'Not closing', 6, oi.issue_key, oi.title, CONCAT('In ', ms.sprints, ' sprints without closing'),
    GREATEST(TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, ms.first_start, NOW()), 0), oi.project_name, NULLIF(oi.assignee_name, ''), oi.url, CONCAT('issue:', oi.id), oi.last_activity
  FROM open_issues oi
  JOIN multi_sprint ms ON ms.issue_id = oi.id
  WHERE oi.is_jira
  UNION ALL
  SELECT CASE oi.priority WHEN 'Highest' THEN 'Critical' WHEN 'High' THEN 'High' WHEN 'Medium' THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END,
    CASE oi.priority WHEN 'Highest' THEN 1 WHEN 'High' THEN 2 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END,
    'Open bug', 7, oi.issue_key, oi.title,
    CONCAT(COALESCE(NULLIF(oi.priority, ''), 'Unprioritised'), ' bug open ', GREATEST(TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, oi.created_date, NOW()), 0), 'd'),
    GREATEST(TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, oi.created_date, NOW()), 0), oi.project_name, NULLIF(oi.assignee_name, ''), oi.url, CONCAT('issue:', oi.id), oi.last_activity
  FROM open_issues oi
  WHERE (oi.type = 'BUG' OR (oi.id LIKE 'github:%' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM issue_labels il WHERE il.issue_id = oi.id AND il.label_name IN ('bug','Production-Bug'))))
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Medium', 3, 'Unassigned in Ready', 8, oi.issue_key, oi.title,
    CONCAT(oi.original_status, ' for ', GREATEST(TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, oi.status_since, NOW()), 0), 'd, no assignee'),
    GREATEST(TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, oi.status_since, NOW()), 0), oi.project_name, NULL, oi.url, CONCAT('issue:', oi.id), oi.last_activity
  FROM open_issues oi
  WHERE oi.is_jira AND (oi.original_status IN ('Selected for Development', 'Dev Ready', 'Ready for Dev', 'Ready for Development') OR (oi.original_status IN ('To do', 'To Do', 'Todo') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sprint_issues si_r JOIN sprints sp_r ON sp_r.id = si_r.sprint_id WHERE si_r.issue_id = oi.id AND sp_r.status = 'ACTIVE'))) AND COALESCE(oi.assignee_id, '') = ''
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Critical', 1, 'Failed deploy', 9, CONCAT(ld.env, ' · ', LEFT(ld.sha, 7)), CONCAT(cs.name, ' · ', ld.env),
    CONCAT('Latest prod deployment failed ', GREATEST(TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, ld.ts, NOW()), 0), 'd ago, no success since'),
    GREATEST(TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, ld.ts, NOW()), 0), pc.project_name, NULL, ld.url, CONCAT('deploy:', ld.scope_id, ':', ld.env), ld.ts
  FROM latest_deploy ld
  JOIN project_cicd pc ON pc.scope_id = ld.scope_id
  JOIN cicd_scopes cs ON cs.id = ld.scope_id
  WHERE ld.rn = 1 AND ld.failed = 1 AND ld.ts >= NOW() - INTERVAL 90 DAY
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Medium', 3, 'Scope added', 10, oi.issue_key, oi.title, CONCAT('Added to the active sprint ', GREATEST(TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, sa.added_at, NOW()), 0), 'd ago'),
    GREATEST(TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, sa.added_at, NOW()), 0), oi.project_name, NULLIF(oi.assignee_name, ''), oi.url, CONCAT('issue:', oi.id), oi.last_activity
  FROM open_issues oi
  JOIN scope_added sa ON sa.issue_id = oi.id
  WHERE oi.is_jira
),
attention AS (
  SELECT severity, severity_rank, category, item, title, reason, age_days, project_name, owner, url, last_activity
  FROM (
    SELECT ar.severity, ar.severity_rank, ar.category, ar.item, ar.title, ar.reason, ar.age_days, ar.project_name, ar.owner, ar.url, ar.last_activity,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ar.project_name, ar.ref ORDER BY ar.severity_rank, ar.cat_rank) AS pick
    FROM att_raw ar
    
  ) ranked_items
  WHERE pick = 1
)

  ELSE CONCAT('**', FORMAT(COUNT(*), 0), '** ', IF(COUNT(*) = 1, 'item needs', 'items need'), ' attention, of which **',
    FORMAT(COUNT(CASE WHEN severity = 'Critical' THEN 1 END), 0), '** ', IF(COUNT(CASE WHEN severity = 'Critical' THEN 1 END) = 1, 'is', 'are'), ' critical.') END AS n_attention_clause
FROM attention

),

  FROM issues i

    AND COALESCE(i.type, '') <> 'EPIC'
),
counts AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(created_date >= NOW() - INTERVAL 28 DAY AND status_bucket = 'DONE') AS done,
    SUM(created_date >= NOW() - INTERVAL 28 DAY) AS total,
    SUM(created_date < NOW() - INTERVAL 28 DAY AND status_bucket = 'DONE') AS prev_done,
    SUM(created_date < NOW() - INTERVAL 28 DAY) AS prev_total
  FROM created
)
SELECT CONCAT(done, '/', total) AS value,
  CONCAT(COALESCE(CONCAT(ROUND(100 * done / NULLIF(total, 0)), '%'), '–'), ' done, was ',
    COALESCE(CONCAT(ROUND(100 * prev_done / NULLIF(prev_total, 0)), '%'), '–')) AS label
FROM counts

spec.title: By project
spec.description: Coverage is weighted by lines to cover and shows red below 50, orange below 70, green from 70. Quality gate status is not collected.

spec.rawSql:
WITH
scoped_cq AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT pm.row_id AS cq_id
  FROM project_mapping pm
  WHERE pm.`table` = 'cq_projects' AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project))
)
, files AS (
  SELECT fm.project_key,
    100 * (1 - SUM(fm.uncovered_lines) / NULLIF(SUM(fm.lines_to_cover), 0)) AS coverage,
    SUM(fm.security_hotspots * (1 - fm.security_hotspots_reviewed / 100)) AS hotspots,
    SUM(fm.sqale_index) / 480 AS debt
  FROM cq_file_metrics fm
  WHERE fm.project_key IN (SELECT cq_id FROM scoped_cq)
  GROUP BY fm.project_key
),
open_issues AS (
  SELECT ci.project_key,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ci.type = 'BUG' THEN ci.id END) AS bugs,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ci.type = 'VULNERABILITY' THEN ci.id END) AS vulns
  FROM cq_issues ci
  WHERE ci.project_key IN (SELECT cq_id FROM scoped_cq)
    AND ci.type IN ('BUG', 'VULNERABILITY') AND COALESCE(ci.status, '') NOT IN ('CLOSED', 'RESOLVED')
  GROUP BY ci.project_key
)
SELECT cp.name AS Project,
  ROUND(f.coverage, 1) AS "Coverage %",
  COALESCE(oi.bugs, 0) AS Bugs,
  COALESCE(oi.vulns, 0) AS Vulns,
  ROUND(f.hotspots) AS "Hotspots unreviewed",
  ROUND(f.debt, 1) AS "Debt (d)",
  cp.last_analysis_date AS "Last analysis"
FROM cq_projects cp
JOIN scoped_cq sc ON sc.cq_id = cp.id
LEFT JOIN files f ON f.project_key = cp.id
LEFT JOIN open_issues oi ON oi.project_key = cp.id
ORDER BY cp.name

spec.description: Tickets open now or resolved in the last 28 days, per group, split into done, in progress and to do. Jira uses its status; GitHub and GitLab issues count as in progress when a linked pull request is open, otherwise when they have an assignee. Blocked tickets count as in progress.

spec.rawSql:
WITH
scoped_boards AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT pm.row_id AS board_id
  FROM project_mapping pm
  WHERE pm.`table` = 'boards' AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project))
),
scoped_issues AS (

  FROM board_issues bi
  JOIN scoped_boards sb ON sb.board_id = bi.board_id
)
, tickets AS (
  SELECT i.id, i.due_date, i.fix_versions, i.epic_key, i.id LIKE 'jira:%' AS is_jira, CASE WHEN i.original_status = 'Closed' THEN 'DONE' WHEN i.original_status IN ('To Do', 'To do', 'Todo') THEN 'TODO' WHEN i.original_status = 'Ready for Development' THEN 'TODO' WHEN i.id NOT LIKE 'jira:%' AND i.status <> 'DONE' THEN CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pull_request_issues pri JOIN pull_requests p2 ON p2.id = pri.pull_request_id AND p2.status = 'OPEN' WHERE pri.issue_id = i.id) THEN 'IN_PROGRESS' WHEN COALESCE(i.assignee_id, '') <> '' THEN 'IN_PROGRESS' ELSE 'TODO' END ELSE i.status END AS bucket
  FROM issues i
  WHERE i.id IN (SELECT issue_id FROM scoped_issues)
    AND COALESCE(i.type, '') <> 'EPIC'
    AND (i.resolution_date IS NULL
      OR (i.resolution_date >= NOW() - INTERVAL 28 DAY AND i.resolution_date < NOW()
        AND COALESCE(i.original_status, '') NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Invalid')))
),
epics AS (
  SELECT e.issue_key, MIN(e.title) AS title
  FROM issues e
  WHERE e.type = 'EPIC' AND e.issue_key <> '' AND e.id IN (SELECT issue_id FROM scoped_issues)
  GROUP BY e.issue_key
),
grouped AS (
  SELECT t.id, COALESCE(il.label_name, 'Unlabelled') AS grp, NULL AS due
  FROM tickets t LEFT JOIN issue_labels il ON il.issue_id = t.id
  WHERE '$grouping' = 'Label'
  UNION
  SELECT bi.issue_id, b.name, NULL
  FROM scoped_boards sb
  JOIN board_issues bi ON bi.board_id = sb.board_id
  JOIN boards b ON b.id = bi.board_id
  WHERE '$grouping' = 'Board'
  UNION
  SELECT t.id, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.fix_versions, ',', 1)), ''), 'No milestone'), IF(NULLIF(TRIM(SUBSTRING_INDEX(t.fix_versions, ',', 1)), '') IS NULL, NULL, t.due_date)
  FROM tickets t
  WHERE '$grouping' = 'Milestone' AND t.is_jira
  UNION
  SELECT t.id, COALESCE(s.name, 'No milestone'), IF(s.name IS NULL, NULL, s.ended_date)
  FROM tickets t
  LEFT JOIN sprint_issues si ON si.issue_id = t.id
  LEFT JOIN sprints s ON s.id = si.sprint_id
  WHERE '$grouping' = 'Milestone' AND NOT t.is_jira
  UNION
  SELECT t.id, COALESCE(e.title, 'No epic'), IF(e.title IS NULL, NULL, t.due_date)
  FROM tickets t
  LEFT JOIN epics e ON e.issue_key = t.epic_key
  WHERE '$grouping' = 'Epic'
)
SELECT CONCAT(g.grp, ' · ', COUNT(*), ' issues',
    IF(MAX(g.due) IS NOT NULL, CONCAT(' · due ', DATE_FORMAT(MAX(g.due), '%e %b')), ''),
    ' · ', ROUND(100 * SUM(t.bucket = 'DONE') / COUNT(*)), '% · ',
    CASE WHEN SUM(t.is_jira) = COUNT(*) THEN 'Jira status' WHEN SUM(t.is_jira) = 0 THEN 'linked PRs or assignee' ELSE 'mixed' END) AS label,

FROM grouped g
JOIN tickets t ON t.id = g.id
GROUP BY g.grp
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, g.grp

spec.description: Share of production deployments in the last 28 days followed, before the next production deployment, by a merged revert or hotfix PR in the same repository; the label compares with the 28 days before.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT value FROM (
WITH
project_cicd AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT pm.project_name, pm.row_id AS scope_id
  FROM project_mapping pm
  WHERE pm.`table` = 'cicd_scopes' AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project))
)
, deploys AS (
  SELECT dc.cicd_deployment_id AS id, dc.cicd_scope_id AS scope_id, LOWER(dc.environment) AS env, MIN(dc.repo_id) AS repo_id, MIN(dc.finished_date) AS ts
  FROM cicd_deployment_commits dc
  WHERE dc.cicd_scope_id IN (SELECT scope_id FROM project_cicd)
    AND dc.result = 'SUCCESS' AND LOWER(dc.environment) LIKE '%prod%'
    AND dc.finished_date >= NOW() - INTERVAL 56 DAY AND dc.finished_date < NOW()
  GROUP BY dc.cicd_deployment_id, dc.cicd_scope_id, LOWER(dc.environment)
),
spans AS (
  SELECT id, scope_id, repo_id, ts, LEAD(ts) OVER (PARTITION BY scope_id, env ORDER BY ts) AS next_ts FROM deploys
),
fixes AS (
  SELECT pr.base_repo_id AS repo_id, pr.merged_date
  FROM pull_requests pr
  WHERE pr.merged_date >= NOW() - INTERVAL 56 DAY
    AND (pr.title LIKE 'Revert%' OR pr.head_ref LIKE 'hotfix/%' OR pr.head_ref LIKE 'revert-%')
),
failed AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT s.id
  FROM spans s
  JOIN fixes f ON f.repo_id = s.repo_id AND f.merged_date > s.ts AND f.merged_date <= COALESCE(s.next_ts, NOW())
),
rates AS (
  SELECT
    100 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ts >= NOW() - INTERVAL 28 DAY AND id IN (SELECT id FROM failed) THEN id END)
      / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ts >= NOW() - INTERVAL 28 DAY THEN id END), 0) AS cur,
    100 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ts < NOW() - INTERVAL 28 DAY AND id IN (SELECT id FROM failed) THEN id END)
      / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ts < NOW() - INTERVAL 28 DAY THEN id END), 0) AS prev

spec.title: Tickets closed
spec.description: Tickets closed in the last 7 days, newest first; cycle time runs from the first in-progress status to resolution. Epics and cancelled or invalid tickets are not counted.

spec.rawSql:
WITH
scoped_boards AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT pm.row_id AS board_id
  FROM project_mapping pm
  WHERE pm.`table` = 'boards' AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project))

scoped_issues AS (

  FROM board_issues bi
  JOIN scoped_boards sb ON sb.board_id = bi.board_id
),
closed AS (
  SELECT i.id, i.resolution_date
  FROM issues i
  WHERE i.id IN (SELECT issue_id FROM scoped_issues)
    AND i.resolution_date >= NOW() - INTERVAL 70 DAY AND i.resolution_date < NOW()
    AND COALESCE(i.type, '') <> 'EPIC'
    AND COALESCE(i.original_status, '') NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Invalid')
),
project_boards AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT pm.project_name, pm.row_id AS board_id
  FROM project_mapping pm
  WHERE pm.`table` = 'boards' AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project))
),
started AS (
  SELECT h.issue_id AS id, MIN(h.start_date) AS started_date
  FROM issue_status_history h
  WHERE h.status = 'IN_PROGRESS' AND h.issue_id IN (SELECT id FROM closed)
  GROUP BY h.issue_id
)
SELECT i.issue_key AS "Key", i.title AS "Title", COALESCE(NULLIF(i.type, ''), 'Untyped') AS "Type", i.priority AS "Priority",
  (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT pb.project_name ORDER BY pb.project_name SEPARATOR ', ')
    FROM board_issues bi JOIN project_boards pb ON pb.board_id = bi.board_id WHERE bi.issue_id = i.id) AS "Team",
  NULLIF(i.assignee_name, '') AS "Assignee",
  NULLIF(i.story_point, 0) AS "Points",
  GREATEST(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, st.started_date, i.resolution_date), 0) / 1440 AS "Cycle (d)",
  i.url AS url
FROM closed c
JOIN issues i ON i.id = c.id
LEFT JOIN started st ON st.id = c.id
WHERE c.resolution_date >= NOW() - INTERVAL 7 DAY
ORDER BY i.resolution_date DESC

spec.title: Merged pull requests
spec.description: Pull requests merged in the last 7 days, newest first. Deployed is Yes when the PR is linked to a production deployment, No when its repository deployed to production in the last 90 days but not this PR, and Unknown otherwise. AI means an AI-assisted commit.

spec.rawSql:
WITH
project_repos AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT pm.project_name, pm.row_id AS repo_id
  FROM project_mapping pm
  WHERE pm.`table` = 'repos' AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project))
)
, merged AS (
  SELECT pr.id
  FROM pull_requests pr
  WHERE pr.base_repo_id IN (SELECT repo_id FROM project_repos)
    AND pr.merged_date >= NOW() - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND pr.merged_date < NOW()
),
ai_prs AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT prc.pull_request_id AS id
  FROM pull_request_commits prc
  LEFT JOIN commits c ON c.sha = prc.commit_sha
  WHERE prc.pull_request_id IN (SELECT id FROM merged)
    AND (c.message LIKE '%Co-Authored-By: Claude%' OR c.message LIKE '%Generated with [Claude Code]%'
      OR prc.commit_sha IN (SELECT commit_sha FROM ai_commits))
)
SELECT CONCAT('#', pr.pull_request_key) AS "PR", pr.title AS "Title", r.name AS "Repo",
  (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT p3.project_name ORDER BY p3.project_name SEPARATOR ', ') FROM project_repos p3 WHERE p3.repo_id = pr.base_repo_id) AS "Team",
  COALESCE(NULLIF(a.full_name, ''), NULLIF(a.user_name, ''), pr.author_name) AS "Author",
  COALESCE(tk.issue_keys, '–') AS "Ticket",
  DATE_FORMAT(pr.merged_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS "Merged",
  CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM project_pr_metrics ppm WHERE ppm.id = pr.id AND COALESCE(ppm.deployment_commit_id, '') <> '') THEN 'Yes'
    WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM cicd_deployment_commits dc WHERE dc.repo_id = pr.base_repo_id AND dc.result = 'SUCCESS'
      AND LOWER(dc.environment) LIKE '%prod%' AND dc.finished_date >= NOW() - INTERVAL 90 DAY) THEN 'No'
    ELSE 'Unknown' END AS "Deployed",
  CASE WHEN pr.id IN (SELECT id FROM ai_prs) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS "AI",
  pr.url AS url,
  tk.first_url AS ticket_url
FROM merged m
JOIN pull_requests pr ON pr.id = m.id
JOIN repos r ON r.id = pr.base_repo_id
LEFT JOIN accounts a ON a.id = pr.author_id
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT pri.pull_request_id, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT i.issue_key ORDER BY i.issue_key SEPARATOR ', ') AS issue_keys,
    SUBSTRING_INDEX(GROUP_CONCAT(i.url ORDER BY i.issue_key SEPARATOR ' '), ' ', 1) AS first_url
  FROM pull_request_issues pri
  JOIN issues i ON i.id = pri.issue_id
  GROUP BY pri.pull_request_id
) tk ON tk.pull_request_id = pr.id
ORDER BY pr.merged_date DESC

spec.title: Contribution mix
spec.description: Counts for the last 7 days, one row per person and project, not a verdict: there is no combined score. Reviews are review comments on other people's PRs; Verified is Jira only. People are matched by display name, so one person using different names in different tools appears as separate rows.

spec.rawSql:
WITH
project_repos AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT pm.project_name, pm.row_id AS repo_id
  FROM project_mapping pm
  WHERE pm.`table` = 'repos' AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project))

)
, win_prs AS (
  SELECT pr.id, pr.author_id, pr.author_name, pr.base_repo_id, pr.created_date
  FROM pull_requests pr
  WHERE pr.created_date >= NOW() - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND pr.created_date < NOW()
),
win_comments AS (
  SELECT cm.id, cm.type, cm.account_id, cm.pull_request_id, cm.created_date
  FROM pull_request_comments cm
  WHERE cm.created_date >= NOW() - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND cm.created_date < NOW() AND cm.type IN ('REVIEW', 'DIFF', 'NORMAL')
),
win_commits AS (
  SELECT c.sha, c.author_name, c.authored_date
  FROM commits c
  WHERE c.authored_date >= NOW() - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND c.authored_date < NOW()
),
win_changelogs AS (
  SELECT ic.id, ic.issue_id, ic.author_name, ic.created_date, ic.original_from_value, ic.original_to_value, ic.field_name
  FROM issue_changelogs ic
  WHERE ic.field_name = 'status' AND ic.created_date >= NOW() - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND ic.created_date < NOW() AND ic.author_name <> ''
),
events AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(a.full_name, ''), NULLIF(a.user_name, ''), pr.author_name) AS person, pp.project_name, 'pr' AS kind, pr.id AS ref, DATE(pr.created_date) AS day
  FROM win_prs pr
  JOIN project_repos pp ON pp.repo_id = pr.base_repo_id
  LEFT JOIN accounts a ON a.id = pr.author_id
  UNION ALL
  SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(a.full_name, ''), NULLIF(a.user_name, ''), cm.account_id), pp.project_name,
    CASE WHEN cm.type <> 'REVIEW' THEN 'comment' WHEN cm.account_id <> pr.author_id THEN 'review' ELSE 'own_review' END, cm.id, DATE(cm.created_date)
  FROM win_comments cm
  JOIN pull_requests pr ON pr.id = cm.pull_request_id
  JOIN project_repos pp ON pp.repo_id = pr.base_repo_id
  LEFT JOIN accounts a ON a.id = cm.account_id
  UNION ALL
  SELECT STRAIGHT_JOIN c.author_name, pp.project_name, 'commit', c.sha, DATE(c.authored_date)
  FROM win_commits c
  JOIN project_repos pp
  JOIN repo_commits rc ON rc.repo_id = pp.repo_id AND rc.commit_sha = c.sha
  UNION ALL
  SELECT STRAIGHT_JOIN i.assignee_name, pb.project_name, 'ticket', i.id, NULL
  FROM issues i
  JOIN project_boards pb
  JOIN board_issues bi ON bi.board_id = pb.board_id AND bi.issue_id = i.id
  WHERE i.resolution_date >= NOW() - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND i.resolution_date < NOW()
    AND COALESCE(i.type, '') <> 'EPIC' AND COALESCE(i.original_status, '') NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Invalid') AND i.assignee_name <> ''
  UNION ALL
  SELECT STRAIGHT_JOIN i.creator_name, pb.project_name, 'bug', i.id, NULL
  FROM issues i
  JOIN project_boards pb
  JOIN board_issues bi ON bi.board_id = pb.board_id AND bi.issue_id = i.id
  WHERE i.created_date >= NOW() - INTERVAL 7 DAY AND i.created_date < NOW() AND (i.type = 'BUG' OR (i.id LIKE 'github:%' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM issue_labels il WHERE il.issue_id = i.id AND il.label_name IN ('bug','Production-Bug')))) AND i.creator_name <> ''
  UNION ALL
  SELECT STRAIGHT_JOIN ic.author_name, pb.project_name, CASE WHEN (ic.field_name = 'status' AND ((ic.original_from_value IN ('In QA','QA','QA Review','Internal QA','Testing','Davd''s QA Staging','In Staging','Ready for QA') AND ic.original_to_value IN ('Verified on Staging','ACCEPTANCE','Ready for Deployment','READY FOR RELEASE TO PRODUCTIO','READY FOR RELEASE TO PRODUCTION','Ready to Release','Done','Done - In Prod')) OR ic.original_to_value = 'Verified on Staging')) THEN 'verified' ELSE 'status' END, ic.id, DATE(ic.created_date)
  FROM win_changelogs ic
  JOIN project_boards pb
  JOIN board_issues bi ON bi.board_id = pb.board_id AND bi.issue_id = ic.issue_id
)
SELECT /*+ SET_VAR(optimizer_switch='derived_merge=off') */ person AS "Person", project_name AS "Team",
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN kind = 'pr' THEN ref END) AS "PRs",
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN kind = 'review' THEN ref END) AS "Reviews",
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN kind = 'comment' THEN ref END) AS "Comments",
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN kind = 'ticket' THEN ref END) AS "Tickets",
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN kind = 'bug' THEN ref END) AS "Bugs filed",
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN kind = 'verified' THEN ref END) AS "Verified",
  COUNT(DISTINCT day) AS "Active days"
FROM events
WHERE person IS NOT NULL AND person <> ''
GROUP BY person, project_name
ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN kind IN ('pr', 'review') THEN ref END) DESC, person

options.content: Delivery over eight weeks, and the same measures per team, since an org-wide average hides the team that is struggling.

spec.title: Delivery over eight weeks
spec.description: Pull requests merged and tickets closed on the left axis; successful production deployments (dashed) and staging deployments (dotted) on the right, where their smaller range would flatten against the others. Staging means a non-production environment named like staging, dev, QA, UAT, test or demo. Weekly over eight weeks; the current week is partial.

spec.rawSql:
WITH RECURSIVE
weeks AS (
  SELECT CAST(DATE_SUB(DATE(NOW()), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(NOW()) + 49 DAY) AS DATETIME) AS week_start
  UNION ALL
  SELECT week_start + INTERVAL 7 DAY FROM weeks WHERE week_start < DATE_SUB(DATE(NOW()), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(NOW()) DAY)
),
scoped_repos AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT pm.row_id AS repo_id
  FROM project_mapping pm
  WHERE pm.`table` = 'repos' AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project))
),
scoped_boards AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT pm.row_id AS board_id
  FROM project_mapping pm
  WHERE pm.`table` = 'boards' AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project))
),
scoped_issues AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT bi.issue_id
  FROM board_issues bi
  JOIN scoped_boards sb ON sb.board_id = bi.board_id
),
scoped_cicd AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT pm.row_id AS scope_id
  FROM project_mapping pm
  WHERE pm.`table` = 'cicd_scopes' AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project))
),
closed AS (
  SELECT i.id, i.resolution_date
  FROM issues i
  WHERE i.id IN (SELECT issue_id FROM scoped_issues)
    AND i.resolution_date >= NOW() - INTERVAL 70 DAY AND i.resolution_date < NOW()
    AND COALESCE(i.type, '') <> 'EPIC'
    AND COALESCE(i.original_status, '') NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Invalid')
)
, merged AS (
  SELECT DATE_SUB(DATE(pr.merged_date), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(pr.merged_date) DAY) AS week_start, COUNT(DISTINCT pr.id) AS n
  FROM pull_requests pr
  WHERE pr.base_repo_id IN (SELECT repo_id FROM scoped_repos)
    AND pr.merged_date >= (SELECT MIN(week_start) FROM weeks) AND pr.merged_date < NOW()
  GROUP BY 1
),
tickets AS (
  SELECT DATE_SUB(DATE(resolution_date), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(resolution_date) DAY) AS week_start, COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS n
  FROM closed
  GROUP BY 1
),
deploys AS (
  SELECT DATE_SUB(DATE(dc.finished_date), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(dc.finished_date) DAY) AS week_start, COUNT(DISTINCT dc.cicd_deployment_id) AS n
  FROM cicd_deployment_commits dc
  WHERE dc.cicd_scope_id IN (SELECT scope_id FROM scoped_cicd)
    AND dc.result = 'SUCCESS' AND LOWER(dc.environment) LIKE '%prod%'
    AND dc.finished_date >= (SELECT MIN(week_start) FROM weeks) AND dc.finished_date < NOW()
  GROUP BY 1
),

  SELECT DATE_SUB(DATE(dc.finished_date), INTERVAL WEEKDAY(dc.finished_date) DAY) AS week_start, COUNT(DISTINCT dc.cicd_deployment_id) AS n
  FROM cicd_deployment_commits dc
  WHERE dc.cicd_scope_id IN (SELECT scope_id FROM scoped_cicd)
    AND dc.result = 'SUCCESS' AND LOWER(dc.environment) NOT LIKE '%prod%' AND LOWER(dc.environment) REGEXP 'stag|dev|qa|uat|test|demo'
    AND dc.finished_date >= (SELECT MIN(week_start) FROM weeks) AND dc.finished_date < NOW()

FROM weeks w
LEFT JOIN merged m ON m.week_start = w.week_start
LEFT JOIN tickets t ON t.week_start = w.week_start
LEFT JOIN deploys d ON d.week_start = w.week_start

spec.title: Failed deploy recovery
spec.description: Median hours from a failed production deploy to the next success on the same pipeline and environment, for failures in the last 28 days, vs the 28 before. This is recovery from failed deploys, not incident restore time.

spec.rawSql:
WITH
scoped_cicd AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT pm.row_id AS scope_id
  FROM project_mapping pm
  WHERE pm.`table` = 'cicd_scopes' AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project))
),
prod_deploys AS (
  SELECT dc.cicd_scope_id AS scope_id, LOWER(dc.environment) AS env, dc.cicd_deployment_id AS id,
    MIN(dc.repo_id) AS repo_id, MIN(dc.finished_date) AS ts, MIN(dc.commit_sha) AS sha, MIN(dc.name) AS name, MIN(dc.url) AS url, MAX(dc.result IN ('FAILURE', 'FAILED')) AS failed
  FROM cicd_deployment_commits dc
  WHERE dc.cicd_scope_id IN (SELECT scope_id FROM scoped_cicd)
    AND dc.result IN ('SUCCESS', 'FAILURE', 'FAILED') AND LOWER(dc.environment) LIKE '%prod%'
    AND dc.finished_date < NOW()
  GROUP BY dc.cicd_scope_id, LOWER(dc.environment), dc.cicd_deployment_id
)
, seq AS (
  SELECT ts, failed,
    LAG(failed) OVER w AS prev_failed,
    MIN(CASE WHEN failed = 0 THEN ts END) OVER (PARTITION BY scope_id, env ORDER BY ts ROWS BETWEEN 1 FOLLOWING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS restored_ts
  FROM prod_deploys
  WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY scope_id, env ORDER BY ts)
),
restores AS (
  SELECT ts, TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, ts, restored_ts) / 60 AS hours
  FROM seq
  WHERE failed = 1 AND COALESCE(prev_failed, 0) = 0 AND restored_ts IS NOT NULL
    AND ts >= NOW() - INTERVAL 56 DAY
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT hours, ts >= NOW() - INTERVAL 28 DAY AS is_cur,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ts >= NOW() - INTERVAL 28 DAY ORDER BY hours) AS rn,
    COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY ts >= NOW() - INTERVAL 28 DAY) AS n
  FROM restores
)
SELECT NOW() - INTERVAL 28 DAY AS time, MAX(hours) AS value FROM ranked WHERE is_cur = 0 AND rn = CEIL(0.5 * n)
UNION ALL
SELECT NOW() AS time, MAX(hours) AS value FROM ranked WHERE is_cur = 1 AND rn = CEIL(0.5 * n)

spec.title: Where the time goes in a pull request
spec.description: Median and 85th percentile hours for each stage, for PRs merged in the last 28 days; each stage counts the PRs where it is recorded. Deploy covers only PRs linked to a production deployment, and the label shows how many. The stage to fix is the one with the widest gap between the two.

spec.rawSql:
WITH
scoped_repos AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT pm.row_id AS repo_id
  FROM project_mapping pm
  WHERE pm.`table` = 'repos' AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project))
)
, prs AS (
  SELECT pr.id, MIN(ppm.pr_coding_time) AS coding, MIN(ppm.pr_pickup_time) AS pickup,
    MIN(ppm.pr_review_time) AS review, MIN(ppm.pr_deploy_time) AS deploy
  FROM pull_requests pr
  JOIN project_pr_metrics ppm ON ppm.id = pr.id AND ppm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project))
  WHERE pr.base_repo_id IN (SELECT repo_id FROM scoped_repos)
    AND pr.merged_date >= NOW() - INTERVAL 28 DAY AND pr.merged_date < NOW()
  GROUP BY pr.id
),
stages AS (
  SELECT 'Coding' AS stage, 1 AS ord, coding AS minutes FROM prs WHERE coding IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL SELECT 'Pickup', 2, pickup FROM prs WHERE pickup IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL SELECT 'Review', 3, review FROM prs WHERE review IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL SELECT 'Deploy', 4, deploy FROM prs WHERE deploy IS NOT NULL
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT stage, ord, minutes / 60 AS hours,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY stage ORDER BY minutes) AS rn,
    COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY stage) AS n
  FROM stages
)
SELECT CASE WHEN stage = 'Deploy' THEN CONCAT('Deploy (n=', MAX(n), ')') ELSE stage END AS Stage,
  ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN rn = CEIL(0.5 * n) THEN hours END), 1) AS "Median (h)",
  ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN rn = CEIL(0.85 * n) THEN hours END), 1) AS "p85 (h)"
FROM ranked
GROUP BY stage, ord
ORDER BY ord

WITH
project_repos AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT pm.project_name, pm.row_id AS repo_id
  FROM project_mapping pm
  WHERE pm.`table` = 'repos' AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project))
),
project_boards AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT pm.project_name, pm.row_id AS board_id
  FROM project_mapping pm
  WHERE pm.`table` = 'boards' AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project))
),
project_cicd AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT pm.project_name, pm.row_id AS scope_id
  FROM project_mapping pm
  WHERE pm.`table` = 'cicd_scopes' AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project))
),
scoped_cicd AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT pm.row_id AS scope_id
  FROM project_mapping pm
  WHERE pm.`table` = 'cicd_scopes' AND pm.project_name IN (SELECT upm_g.project_name FROM user_project_mapping upm_g WHERE upm_g.user_login = ${__user.login:sqlstring} AND upm_g.project_name IN ($project))
),
prod_deploys AS (
  SELECT dc.cicd_scope_id AS scope_id, LOWER(dc.environment) AS env, dc.cicd_deployment_id AS id,
    MIN(dc.repo_id) AS repo_id, MIN(dc.finished_date) AS ts, MIN(dc.commit_sha) AS sha, MIN(dc.name) AS name, MIN(dc.url) AS url, MAX(dc.result IN ('FAILURE', 'FAILED')) AS failed
  FROM cicd_deployment_commits dc
  WHERE dc.cicd_scope_id IN (SELECT scope_id FROM scoped_cicd)
    AND dc.result IN ('SUCCESS', 'FAILURE', 'FAILED') AND LOWER(dc.environment) LIKE '%prod%'
    AND dc.finished_date < NOW()
  GROUP BY dc.cicd_scope_id, LOWER(dc.environment), dc.cicd_deployment_id
),
issue_base AS (
  SELECT pb.project_name, pb.board_id, i.id, i.issue_key, i.title, i.url, i.priority, i.type, i.status, i.original_status,
    i.assignee_id, i.assignee_name, i.created_date, i.id LIKE 'jira:%' AS is_jira,
    COALESCE(i.updated_date, i.created_date) AS last_activity, i.updated_date
  FROM project_boards pb
  JOIN board_issues bi ON bi.board_id = pb.board_id
  JOIN issues i ON i.id = bi.issue_id
  WHERE i.status <> 'DONE' AND COALESCE(i.type, '') <> 'EPIC'
    AND COALESCE(i.original_status, '') NOT IN ('Closed', 'Cancelled', 'Invalid')
    AND COALESCE(i.updated_date, i.created_date) >= NOW() - INTERVAL 90 DAY
),
status_now AS (
  SELECT h.issue_id, MAX(h.start_date) AS since
  FROM issue_status_history h
  WHERE h.is_current_status = 1 AND h.issue_id IN (SELECT id FROM issue_base)
  GROUP BY h.issue_id
),
first_progress AS (
  SELECT h.issue_id, MIN(h.start_date) AS started
  FROM issue_status_history h
  WHERE h.status = 'IN_PROGRESS' AND h.issue_id IN (SELECT id FROM issue_base)
  GROUP BY h.issue_id
),
open_issues AS (
  SELECT ib.project_name, ib.board_id, ib.id, ib.issue_key, ib.title, ib.url, ib.priority, ib.type, ib.status, ib.original_status,
    ib.assignee_id, ib.assignee_name, ib.created_date, ib.is_jira, ib.last_activity,
    COALESCE(sn.since, ib.updated_date, ib.created_date) AS status_since
  FROM issue_base ib
  LEFT JOIN status_now sn ON sn.issue_id = ib.id
)
, merged_90 AS (
  SELECT pr.id, pr.base_repo_id AS repo_id, TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, pr.created_date, pr.merged_date) AS merge_min
  FROM pull_requests pr
  WHERE pr.base_repo_id IN (SELECT repo_id FROM project_repos)
    AND pr.merged_date >= NOW() - INTERVAL 90 DAY AND pr.merged_date < NOW()
),
repo_med AS (
  SELECT repo_id,
    MAX(CASE WHEN kind = 'merge' AND rn = CEIL(0.5 * n) THEN v END) AS merge_median,
    MAX(CASE WHEN kind = 'pickup' AND rn = CEIL(0.5 * n) THEN v END) AS pickup_median
  FROM (
    SELECT repo_id, kind, v,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY repo_id, kind ORDER BY v) AS rn,
      COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY repo_id, kind) AS n
    FROM (
      SELECT repo_id, 'merge' AS kind, merge_min AS v FROM merged_90
      UNION ALL
      SELECT m.repo_id, 'pickup', MIN(ppm.pr_pickup_time)
      FROM merged_90 m
      JOIN project_pr_metrics ppm ON ppm.id = m.id
      WHERE ppm.pr_pickup_time IS NOT NULL
      GROUP BY m.id, m.repo_id
    ) vals
  ) ranked
  GROUP BY repo_id
),
open_prs_all AS (
  SELECT pr.id, pr.base_repo_id AS repo_id, pp.project_name, CONCAT('#', pr.pull_request_key) AS item, pr.title, pr.url,
    pr.created_date, TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, pr.created_date, NOW()) AS age_min,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(a.full_name, ''), NULLIF(a.user_name, ''), pr.author_name) AS owner
  FROM pull_requests pr
  JOIN project_repos pp ON pp.repo_id = pr.base_repo_id
  LEFT JOIN accounts a ON a.id = pr.author_id
  WHERE pr.status = 'OPEN' AND COALESCE(pr.is_draft, 0) = 0 AND pr.created_date < NOW()
),
pr_comment_last AS (
  SELECT c.pull_request_id, MAX(c.created_date) AS last_at
  FROM pull_request_comments c
  WHERE c.pull_request_id IN (SELECT id FROM open_prs_all)
  GROUP BY c.pull_request_id
),
pr_commit_last AS (
  SELECT prc.pull_request_id, MAX(prc.commit_authored_date) AS last_at
  FROM pull_request_commits prc
  WHERE prc.pull_request_id IN (SELECT id FROM open_prs_all)
  GROUP BY prc.pull_request_id
),
open_prs AS (
  SELECT x.id, x.repo_id, x.project_name, x.item, x.title, x.url, x.created_date, x.age_min, x.owner, x.last_activity
  FROM (
    SELECT op.id, op.repo_id, op.project_name, op.item, op.title, op.url, op.created_date, op.age_min, op.owner,
      GREATEST(op.created_date, COALESCE(cl.last_at, op.created_date), COALESCE(kl.last_at, op.created_date)) AS last_activity
    FROM open_prs_all op
    LEFT JOIN pr_comment_last cl ON cl.pull_request_id = op.id
    LEFT JOIN pr_commit_last kl ON kl.pull_request_id = op.id
  ) x
  WHERE x.age_min >= 0 AND x.last_activity >= NOW() - INTERVAL 90 DAY
),
stale_prs AS (
  SELECT op.id, op.project_name, op.item, op.title, op.url, op.owner, op.age_min, op.last_activity
  FROM open_prs op
  LEFT JOIN repo_med rm ON rm.repo_id = op.repo_id
  WHERE op.age_min > COALESCE(2 * rm.merge_median, 14 * 1440)
),
waiting_reviews AS (
  SELECT op.id, op.project_name, op.item, op.title, op.url, op.age_min, op.last_activity,
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT COALESCE(NULLIF(prr.name, ''), prr.user_name) ORDER BY COALESCE(NULLIF(prr.name, ''), prr.user_name) SEPARATOR ', ') AS reviewers
  FROM open_prs op
  JOIN pull_request_reviewers prr ON prr.pull_request_id = op.id
  WHERE op.age_min > 2 * 1440
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM pull_request_comments c
      WHERE c.pull_request_id = op.id AND c.account_id = prr.reviewer_id AND c.type IN ('REVIEW', 'DIFF'))
  GROUP BY op.id, op.project_name, op.item, op.title, op.url, op.age_min, op.last_activity
),
resolved_90 AS (
  SELECT i.id, bi.board_id, i.resolution_date
  FROM issues i
  JOIN board_issues bi ON bi.issue_id = i.id
  WHERE bi.board_id IN (SELECT board_id FROM project_boards)
    AND i.resolution_date >= NOW() - INTERVAL 90 DAY AND i.resolution_date < NOW()
    AND COALESCE(i.type, '') <> 'EPIC' AND COALESCE(i.original_status, '') NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Invalid')
),
resolved_start AS (
  SELECT h.issue_id, MIN(h.start_date) AS started
  FROM issue_status_history h
  WHERE h.status = 'IN_PROGRESS' AND h.issue_id IN (SELECT id FROM resolved_90)
  GROUP BY h.issue_id
),
board_med AS (
  SELECT board_id, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = CEIL(0.5 * n) THEN days END) AS median_days
  FROM (
    SELECT r.board_id, TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, rs.started, r.resolution_date) / 1440 AS days,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.board_id ORDER BY TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, rs.started, r.resolution_date)) AS rn,
      COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY r.board_id) AS n
    FROM resolved_90 r
    JOIN resolved_start rs ON rs.issue_id = r.id
  ) ranked
  GROUP BY board_id
),
stalled AS (
  SELECT oi.project_name, oi.id, oi.issue_key, oi.title, oi.url, oi.assignee_name, oi.last_activity,
    TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, COALESCE(fp.started, oi.status_since), NOW()) / 24 AS days_in_progress,
    COALESCE(2 * bm.median_days, 14) AS threshold_days
  FROM open_issues oi
  LEFT JOIN first_progress fp ON fp.issue_id = oi.id
  LEFT JOIN board_med bm ON bm.board_id = oi.board_id
  WHERE oi.is_jira AND CASE WHEN oi.original_status = 'Closed' THEN 'DONE' WHEN oi.original_status IN ('To Do', 'To do', 'Todo') THEN 'TODO' WHEN oi.original_status = 'Ready for Development' THEN 'TODO' WHEN oi.id NOT LIKE 'jira:%' AND oi.status <> 'DONE' THEN CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pull_request_issues pri JOIN pull_requests p2 ON p2.id = pri.pull_request_id AND p2.status = 'OPEN' WHERE pri.issue_id = oi.id) THEN 'IN_PROGRESS' WHEN COALESCE(oi.assignee_id, '') <> '' THEN 'IN_PROGRESS' ELSE 'TODO' END ELSE oi.status END = 'IN_PROGRESS' AND NOT oi.original_status IN ('Blocked', 'Tech Block', 'Business Block')
),
multi_sprint AS (
  SELECT si.issue_id, COUNT(DISTINCT si.sprint_id) AS sprints, MIN(s.started_date) AS first_start
  FROM sprint_issues si
  JOIN sprints s ON s.id = si.sprint_id
  GROUP BY si.issue_id
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT si.sprint_id) >= 2
),
scope_added AS (
  SELECT ic.issue_id, MAX(ic.created_date) AS added_at
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM open_issues WHERE is_jira) oj
  JOIN issue_changelogs ic ON ic.issue_id = oj.id AND ic.field_name = 'Sprint'
  JOIN sprints s ON s.status = 'ACTIVE' AND FIND_IN_SET(s.id, ic.original_to_value) AND NOT FIND_IN_SET(s.id, COALESCE(ic.original_from_value, ''))
  WHERE ic.created_date > s.started_date AND (s.completed_date IS NULL OR ic.created_date < s.completed_date)
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM sprints p
      WHERE FIND_IN_SET(p.id, COALESCE(ic.original_from_value, ''))
        AND p.completed_date BETWEEN ic.created_date - INTERVAL 1 HOUR AND ic.created_date + INTERVAL 1 HOUR)
  GROUP BY ic.issue_id
),
latest_deploy AS (
  SELECT scope_id, env, sha, url, ts, failed, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY scope_id, env ORDER BY ts DESC) AS rn
  FROM prod_deploys
),
att_raw AS (
  SELECT 'High' AS severity, 2 AS severity_rank, 'Unapproved PR' AS category, 2 AS cat_rank, op.item, op.title,
    CONCAT('Open ', FLOOR(op.age_min / 1440), 'd, no approving review') AS reason, FLOOR(op.age_min / 1440) AS age_days,
    op.project_name, op.owner, op.url, CONCAT('pr:', op.id) AS ref, op.last_activity
  FROM open_prs op
  LEFT JOIN repo_med rm ON rm.repo_id = op.repo_id
  WHERE op.age_min > COALESCE(rm.pickup_median, 2 * 1440)
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pull_request_comments c WHERE c.pull_request_id = op.id AND c.status = 'APPROVED')
  UNION ALL
  SELECT CASE WHEN sp.age_min > 30 * 1440 AND sp.last_activity < NOW() - INTERVAL 30 DAY THEN 'Low' ELSE 'High' END,
    CASE WHEN sp.age_min > 30 * 1440 AND sp.last_activity < NOW() - INTERVAL 30 DAY THEN 4 ELSE 2 END,
    'Stale PR', 3, sp.item, sp.title,
    CASE WHEN sp.age_min > 30 * 1440 AND sp.last_activity < NOW() - INTERVAL 30 DAY
      THEN CONCAT('Open ', FLOOR(sp.age_min / 1440), 'd, no activity for ', TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, sp.last_activity, NOW()), 'd')
      ELSE CONCAT('Open ', FLOOR(sp.age_min / 1440), 'd, past twice the repo median to merge') END,
    FLOOR(sp.age_min / 1440), sp.project_name, sp.owner, sp.url, CONCAT('pr:', sp.id), sp.last_activity
  FROM stale_prs sp
  UNION ALL
  SELECT CASE WHEN wr.age_min > 3 * 1440 THEN 'High' ELSE 'Medium' END, CASE WHEN wr.age_min > 3 * 1440 THEN 2 ELSE 3 END,
    'Review waiting', 1, wr.item, wr.title, CONCAT('Open ', FLOOR(wr.age_min / 1440), 'd, requested reviewer has not reviewed'),
    FLOOR(wr.age_min / 1440), wr.project_name, wr.reviewers, wr.url, CONCAT('pr:', wr.id), wr.last_activity
  FROM waiting_reviews wr
  UNION ALL
  SELECT CASE WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, oi.status_since, NOW()) > 7 * 24 THEN 'Critical' ELSE 'High' END,
    CASE WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, oi.status_since, NOW()) > 7 * 24 THEN 1 ELSE 2 END,
    'Blocked ticket', 4, oi.issue_key, oi.title,
    CONCAT(oi.original_status, ' for ', GREATEST(TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, oi.status_since, NOW()), 0), 'd'),
    GREATEST(TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, oi.status_since, NOW()), 0), oi.project_name, NULLIF(oi.assignee_name, ''), oi.url, CONCAT('issue:', oi.id), oi.last_activity
  FROM open_issues oi
  WHERE oi.is_jira AND oi.original_status IN ('Blocked', 'Tech Block', 'Business Block')
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'High', 2, 'Stalled ticket', 5, st.issue_key, st.title,
    CONCAT('In progress ', FLOOR(st.days_in_progress), 'd, limit ', FLOOR(st.threshold_days), 'd'),
    FLOOR(st.days_in_progress), st.project_name, NULLIF(st.assignee_name, ''), st.url, CONCAT('issue:', st.id), st.last_activity
  FROM stalled st
  WHERE st.days_in_progress > st.threshold_days
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Medium', 3, 'Not closing', 6, oi.issue_key, oi.title, CONCAT('In ', ms.sprints, ' sprints without closing'),
    GREATEST(TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, ms.first_start, NOW()), 0), oi.project_name, NULLIF(oi.assignee_name, ''), oi.url, CONCAT('issue:', oi.id), oi.last_activity
  FROM open_issues oi
  JOIN multi_sprint ms ON ms.issue_id = oi.id
  WHERE oi.is_jira
  UNION ALL
  SELECT CASE oi.priority WHEN 'Highest' THEN 'Critical' WHEN 'High' THEN 'High' WHEN 'Medium' THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END,
    CASE oi.priority WHEN 'Highest' THEN 1 WHEN 'High' THEN 2 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END,
    'Open bug', 7, oi.issue_key, oi.title,
    CONCAT(COALESCE(NULLIF(oi.priority, ''), 'Unprioritised'), ' bug open ', GREATEST(TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, oi.created_date, NOW()), 0), 'd'),
    GREATEST(TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, oi.created_date, NOW()), 0), oi.project_name, NULLIF(oi.assignee_name, ''), oi.url, CONCAT('issue:', oi.id), oi.last_activity
  FROM open_issues oi
  WHERE (oi.type = 'BUG' OR (oi.id LIKE 'github:%' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM issue_labels il WHERE il.issue_id = oi.id AND il.label_name IN ('bug','Production-Bug'))))
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Medium', 3, 'Unassigned in Ready', 8, oi.issue_key, oi.title,
    CONCAT(oi.original_status, ' for ', GREATEST(TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, oi.status_since, NOW()), 0), 'd, no assignee'),
    GREATEST(TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, oi.status_since, NOW()), 0), oi.project_name, NULL, oi.url, CONCAT('issue:', oi.id), oi.last_activity
  FROM open_issues oi
  WHERE oi.is_jira AND (oi.original_status IN ('Selected for Development', 'Dev Ready', 'Ready for Dev', 'Ready for Development') OR (oi.original_status IN ('To do', 'To Do', 'Todo') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sprint_issues si_r JOIN sprints sp_r ON sp_r.id = si_r.sprint_id WHERE si_r.issue_id = oi.id AND sp_r.status = 'ACTIVE'))) AND COALESCE(oi.assignee_id, '') = ''
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Critical', 1, 'Failed deploy', 9, CONCAT(ld.env, ' · ', LEFT(ld.sha, 7)), CONCAT(cs.name, ' · ', ld.env),
    CONCAT('Latest prod deployment failed ', GREATEST(TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, ld.ts, NOW()), 0), 'd ago, no success since'),
    GREATEST(TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, ld.ts, NOW()), 0), pc.project_name, NULL, ld.url, CONCAT('deploy:', ld.scope_id, ':', ld.env), ld.ts
  FROM latest_deploy ld
  JOIN project_cicd pc ON pc.scope_id = ld.scope_id
  JOIN cicd_scopes cs ON cs.id = ld.scope_id
  WHERE ld.rn = 1 AND ld.failed = 1 AND ld.ts >= NOW() - INTERVAL 90 DAY
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Medium', 3, 'Scope added', 10, oi.issue_key, oi.title, CONCAT('Added to the active sprint ', GREATEST(TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, sa.added_at, NOW()), 0), 'd ago'),
    GREATEST(TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, sa.added_at, NOW()), 0), oi.project_name, NULLIF(oi.assignee_name, ''), oi.url, CONCAT('issue:', oi.id), oi.last_activity
  FROM open_issues oi
  JOIN scope_added sa ON sa.issue_id = oi.id
  WHERE oi.is_jira
),
attention AS (
  SELECT severity, severity_rank, category, item, title, reason, age_days, project_name, owner, url, last_activity
  FROM (
    SELECT ar.severity, ar.severity_rank, ar.category, ar.item, ar.title, ar.reason, ar.age_days, ar.project_name, ar.owner, ar.url, ar.last_activity,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ar.project_name, ar.ref ORDER BY ar.severity_rank, ar.cat_rank) AS pick
    FROM att_raw ar
    
  ) ranked_items
  WHERE pick = 1
)
SELECT /*+ SET_VAR(optimizer_switch='derived_merge=off') */ CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 'Nothing is waiting on a decision.'
  ELSE CONCAT('**', FORMAT(COUNT(*), 0), '** ', IF(COUNT(*) = 1, 'item is', 'items are'), ' waiting on a decision. The oldest has been open **', MAX(age_days),
    '** days, and the one to pick up first is **', (SELECT item FROM attention ORDER BY severity_rank, age_days DESC, item, project_name LIMIT 1), '**.') END AS n_queue_sentence
FROM attention

spec.title: Severity
spec.description: Counts by severity. Critical: a failed production deploy with no later success, a Highest-priority open bug, or a ticket blocked for more than 7 days. High: unapproved or stale PRs, stalled tickets, reviews waiting more than 3 days and High-priority bugs. Medium: tickets not closing, scope added to the active sprint, unassigned tickets in Ready and Medium-priority bugs. Low: bugs below Medium priority and stale PRs with no activity for 30 days.       SELECT m.repo_id, 'pickup', MIN(ppm.pr_pickup_time)
      FROM merged_90 m
      JOIN project_pr_metrics ppm ON ppm.id = m.id
      WHERE ppm.pr_pickup_time IS NOT NULL
      GROUP BY m.id, m.repo_id
    ) vals
  ) ranked
  GROUP BY repo_id
),
open_prs_all AS (
  SELECT pr.id, pr.base_repo_id AS repo_id, pp.project_name, CONCAT('#', pr.pull_request_key) AS item, pr.title, pr.url,
    pr.created_date, TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, pr.created_date, NOW()) AS age_min,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(a.full_name, ''), NULLIF(a.user_name, ''), pr.author_name) AS owner
  FROM pull_requests pr
  JOIN project_repos pp ON pp.repo_id = pr.base_repo_id
  LEFT JOIN accounts a ON a.id = pr.author_id
  WHERE pr.status = 'OPEN' AND COALESCE(pr.is_draft, 0) = 0 AND pr.created_date < NOW()
),
pr_comment_last AS (
  SELECT c.pull_request_id, MAX(c.created_date) AS last_at
  FROM pull_request_comments c
  WHERE c.pull_request_id IN (SELECT id FROM open_prs_all)
  GROUP BY c.pull_request_id
),
pr_commit_last AS (
  SELECT prc.pull_request_id, MAX(prc.commit_authored_date) AS last_at
  FROM pull_request_commits prc
  WHERE prc.pull_request_id IN (SELECT id FROM open_prs_all)
  GROUP BY prc.pull_request_id
),
open_prs AS (
  SELECT x.id, x.repo_id, x.project_name, x.item, x.title, x.url, x.created_date, x.age_min, x.owner, x.last_activity
  FROM (
    SELECT op.id, op.repo_id, op.project_name, op.item, op.title, op.url, op.created_date, op.age_min, op.owner,
      GREATEST(op.created_date, COALESCE(cl.last_at, op.created_date), COALESCE(kl.last_at, op.created_date)) AS last_activity
    FROM open_prs_all op
    LEFT JOIN pr_comment_last cl ON cl.pull_request_id = op.id
    LEFT JOIN pr_commit_last kl ON kl.pull_request_id = op.id
  ) x
  WHERE x.age_min >= 0 AND x.last_activity >= NOW() - INTERVAL 90 DAY
),
stale_prs AS (
  SELECT op.id, op.project_name, op.item, op.title, op.url, op.owner, op.age_min, op.last_activity
  FROM open_prs op
  LEFT JOIN repo_med rm ON rm.repo_id = op.repo_id
  WHERE op.age_min > COALESCE(2 * rm.merge_median, 14 * 1440)
),
waiting_reviews AS (
  SELECT op.id, op.project_name, op.item, op.title, op.url, op.age_min, op.last_activity,
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT COALESCE(NULLIF(prr.name, ''), prr.user_name) ORDER BY COALESCE(NULLIF(prr.name, ''), prr.user_name) SEPARATOR ', ') AS reviewers
  FROM open_prs op
  JOIN pull_request_reviewers prr ON prr.pull_request_id = op.id
  WHERE op.age_min > 2 * 1440
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM pull_request_comments c
      WHERE c.pull_request_id = op.id AND c.account_id = prr.reviewer_id AND c.type IN ('REVIEW', 'DIFF'))
  GROUP BY op.id, op.project_name, op.item, op.title, op.url, op.age_min, op.last_activity
),
resolved_90 AS (
  SELECT i.id, bi.board_id, i.resolution_date
  FROM issues i
  JOIN board_issues bi ON bi.issue_id = i.id
  WHERE bi.board_id IN (SELECT board_id FROM project_boards)
    AND i.resolution_date >= NOW() - INTERVAL 90 DAY AND i.resolution_date < NOW()
    AND COALESCE(i.type, '') <> 'EPIC' AND COALESCE(i.original_status, '') NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Invalid')
),
resolved_start AS (
  SELECT h.issue_id, MIN(h.start_date) AS started
  FROM issue_status_history h
  WHERE h.status = 'IN_PROGRESS' AND h.issue_id IN (SELECT id FROM resolved_90)
  GROUP BY h.issue_id
),
board_med AS (
  SELECT board_id, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = CEIL(0.5 * n) THEN days END) AS median_days
  FROM (
    SELECT r.board_id, TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, rs.started, r.resolution_date) / 1440 AS days,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.board_id ORDER BY TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, rs.started, r.resolution_date)) AS rn,
      COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY r.board_id) AS n
    FROM resolved_90 r
    JOIN resolved_start rs ON rs.issue_id = r.id
  ) ranked
  GROUP BY board_id
),
stalled AS (
  SELECT oi.project_name, oi.id, oi.issue_key, oi.title, oi.url, oi.assignee_name, oi.last_activity,
    TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, COALESCE(fp.started, oi.status_since), NOW()) / 24 AS days_in_progress,
    COALESCE(2 * bm.median_days, 14) AS threshold_days
  FROM open_issues oi
  LEFT JOIN first_progress fp ON fp.issue_id = oi.id
  LEFT JOIN board_med bm ON bm.board_id = oi.board_id
  WHERE oi.is_jira AND CASE WHEN oi.original_status = 'Closed' THEN 'DONE' WHEN oi.original_status IN ('To Do', 'To do', 'Todo') THEN 'TODO' WHEN oi.original_status = 'Ready for Development' THEN 'TODO' WHEN oi.id NOT LIKE 'jira:%' AND oi.status <> 'DONE' THEN CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pull_request_issues pri JOIN pull_requests p2 ON p2.id = pri.pull_request_id AND p2.status = 'OPEN' WHERE pri.issue_id = oi.id) THEN 'IN_PROGRESS' WHEN COALESCE(oi.assignee_id, '') <> '' THEN 'IN_PROGRESS' ELSE 'TODO' END ELSE oi.status END = 'IN_PROGRESS' AND NOT oi.original_status IN ('Blocked', 'Tech Block', 'Business Block')
),
multi_sprint AS (
  SELECT si.issue_id, COUNT(DISTINCT si.sprint_id) AS sprints, MIN(s.started_date) AS first_start
  FROM sprint_issues si
  JOIN sprints s ON s.id = si.sprint_id
  GROUP BY si.issue_id
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT si.sprint_id) >= 2
),
scope_added AS (
  SELECT ic.issue_id, MAX(ic.created_date) AS added_at
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM open_issues WHERE is_jira) oj
  JOIN issue_changelogs ic ON ic.issue_id = oj.id AND ic.field_name = 'Sprint'
  JOIN sprints s ON s.status = 'ACTIVE' AND FIND_IN_SET(s.id, ic.original_to_value) AND NOT FIND_IN_SET(s.id, COALESCE(ic.original_from_value, ''))
  WHERE ic.created_date > s.started_date AND (s.completed_date IS NULL OR ic.created_date < s.completed_date)
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM sprints p
      WHERE FIND_IN_SET(p.id, COALESCE(ic.original_from_value, ''))
        AND p.completed_date BETWEEN ic.created_date - INTERVAL 1 HOUR AND ic.created_date + INTERVAL 1 HOUR)
  GROUP BY ic.issue_id
),
latest_deploy AS (
  SELECT scope_id, env, sha, url, ts, failed, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY scope_id, env ORDER BY ts DESC) AS rn
  FROM prod_deploys
),
att_raw AS (
  SELECT 'High' AS severity, 2 AS severity_rank, 'Unapproved PR' AS category, 2 AS cat_rank, op.item, op.title,
    CONCAT('Open ', FLOOR(op.age_min / 1440), 'd, no approving review') AS reason, FLOOR(op.age_min / 1440) AS age_days,
    op.project_name, op.owner, op.url, CONCAT('pr:', op.id) AS ref, op.last_activity
  FROM open_prs op
  LEFT JOIN repo_med rm ON rm.repo_id = op.repo_id
  WHERE op.age_min > COALESCE(rm.pickup_median, 2 * 1440)
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pull_request_comments c WHERE c.pull_request_id = op.id AND c.status = 'APPROVED')
  UNION ALL
  SELECT CASE WHEN sp.age_min > 30 * 1440 AND sp.last_activity < NOW() - INTERVAL 30 DAY THEN 'Low' ELSE 'High' END,
    CASE WHEN sp.age_min > 30 * 1440 AND sp.last_activity < NOW() - INTERVAL 30 DAY THEN 4 ELSE 2 END,
    'Stale PR', 3, sp.item, sp.title,
    CASE WHEN sp.age_min > 30 * 1440 AND sp.last_activity < NOW() - INTERVAL 30 DAY
      THEN CONCAT('Open ', FLOOR(sp.age_min / 1440), 'd, no activity for ', TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, sp.last_activity, NOW()), 'd')
      ELSE CONCAT('Open ', FLOOR(sp.age_min / 1440), 'd, past twice the repo median to merge') END,
    FLOOR(sp.age_min / 1440), sp.project_name, sp.owner, sp.url, CONCAT('pr:', sp.id), sp.last_activity
  FROM stale_prs sp
  UNION ALL
  SELECT CASE WHEN wr.age_min > 3 * 1440 THEN 'High' ELSE 'Medium' END, CASE WHEN wr.age_min > 3 * 1440 THEN 2 ELSE 3 END,
    'Review waiting', 1, wr.item, wr.title, CONCAT('Open ', FLOOR(wr.age_min / 1440), 'd, requested reviewer has not reviewed'),
    FLOOR(wr.age_min / 1440), wr.project_name, wr.reviewers, wr.url, CONCAT('pr:', wr.id), wr.last_activity
  FROM waiting_reviews wr
  UNION ALL
  SELECT CASE WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, oi.status_since, NOW()) > 7 * 24 THEN 'Critical' ELSE 'High' END,
    CASE WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, oi.status_since, NOW()) > 7 * 24 THEN 1 ELSE 2 END,
    'Blocked ticket', 4, oi.issue_key, oi.title,
    CONCAT(oi.original_status, ' for ', GREATEST(TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, oi.status_since, NOW()), 0), 'd'),
    GREATEST(TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, oi.status_since, NOW()), 0), oi.project_name, NULLIF(oi.assignee_name, ''), oi.url, CONCAT('issue:', oi.id), oi.last_activity
  FROM open_issues oi
  WHERE oi.is_jira AND oi.original_status IN ('Blocked', 'Tech Block', 'Business Block')
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'High', 2, 'Stalled ticket', 5, st.issue_key, st.title,
    CONCAT('In progress ', FLOOR(st.days_in_progress), 'd, limit ', FLOOR(st.threshold_days), 'd'),
    FLOOR(st.days_in_progress), st.project_name, NULLIF(st.assignee_name, ''), st.url, CONCAT('issue:', st.id), st.last_activity
  FROM stalled st
  WHERE st.days_in_progress > st.threshold_days
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Medium', 3, 'Not closing', 6, oi.issue_key, oi.title, CONCAT('In ', ms.sprints, ' sprints without closing'),
    GREATEST(TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, ms.first_start, NOW()), 0), oi.project_name, NULLIF(oi.assignee_name, ''), oi.url, CONCAT('issue:', oi.id), oi.last_activity
  FROM open_issues oi
  JOIN multi_sprint ms ON ms.issue_id = oi.id
  WHERE oi.is_jira
  UNION ALL
  SELECT CASE oi.priority WHEN 'Highest' THEN 'Critical' WHEN 'High' THEN 'High' WHEN 'Medium' THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END,
    CASE oi.priority WHEN 'Highest' THEN 1 WHEN 'High' THEN 2 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END,
    'Open bug', 7, oi.issue_key, oi.title,
    CONCAT(COALESCE(NULLIF(oi.priority, ''), 'Unprioritised'), ' bug open ', GREATEST(TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, oi.created_date, NOW()), 0), 'd'),
    GREATEST(TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, oi.created_date, NOW()), 0), oi.project_name, NULLIF(oi.assignee_name, ''), oi.url, CONCAT('issue:', oi.id), oi.last_activity
  FROM open_issues oi
  WHERE (oi.type = 'BUG' OR (oi.id LIKE 'github:%' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM issue_labels il WHERE il.issue_id = oi.id AND il.label_name IN ('bug','Production-Bug'))))
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Medium', 3, 'Unassigned in Ready', 8, oi.issue_key, oi.title,
    CONCAT(oi.original_status, ' for ', GREATEST(TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, oi.status_since, NOW()), 0), 'd, no assignee'),
    GREATEST(TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, oi.status_since, NOW()), 0), oi.project_name, NULL, oi.url, CONCAT('issue:', oi.id), oi.last_activity
  FROM open_issues oi
  WHERE oi.is_jira AND (oi.original_status IN ('Selected for Development', 'Dev Ready', 'Ready for Dev', 'Ready for Development') OR (oi.original_status IN ('To do', 'To Do', 'Todo') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sprint_issues si_r JOIN sprints sp_r ON sp_r.id = si_r.sprint_id WHERE si_r.issue_id = oi.id AND sp_r.status = 'ACTIVE'))) AND COALESCE(oi.assignee_id, '') = ''
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Critical', 1, 'Failed deploy', 9, CONCAT(ld.env, ' · ', LEFT(ld.sha, 7)), CONCAT(cs.name, ' · ', ld.env),
    CONCAT('Latest prod deployment failed ', GREATEST(TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, ld.ts, NOW()), 0), 'd ago, no success since'),
    GREATEST(TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, ld.ts, NOW()), 0), pc.project_name, NULL, ld.url, CONCAT('deploy:', ld.scope_id, ':', ld.env), ld.ts
  FROM latest_deploy ld
  JOIN project_cicd pc ON pc.scope_id = ld.scope_id
  JOIN cicd_scopes cs ON cs.id = ld.scope_id
  WHERE ld.rn = 1 AND ld.failed = 1 AND ld.ts >= NOW() - INTERVAL 90 DAY
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Medium', 3, 'Scope added', 10, oi.issue_key, oi.title, CONCAT('Added to the active sprint ', GREATEST(TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, sa.added_at, NOW()), 0), 'd ago'),
    GREATEST(TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, sa.added_at, NOW()), 0), oi.project_name, NULLIF(oi.assignee_name, ''), oi.url, CONCAT('issue:', oi.id), oi.last_activity
  FROM open_issues oi
  JOIN scope_added sa ON sa.issue_id = oi.id
  WHERE oi.is_jira
),
attention AS (
  SELECT severity, severity_rank, category, item, title, reason, age_days, project_name, owner, url, last_activity
  FROM (
    SELECT ar.severity, ar.severity_rank, ar.category, ar.item, ar.title, ar.reason, ar.age_days, ar.project_name, ar.owner, ar.url, ar.last_activity,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ar.project_name, ar.ref ORDER BY ar.severity_rank, ar.cat_rank) AS pick
    FROM att_raw ar
    
  ) ranked_items
  WHERE pick = 1
)
SELECT /*+ SET_VAR(optimizer_switch='derived_merge=off') */ COUNT(CASE WHEN severity = 'Critical' THEN 1 END) AS Critical,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN severity = 'High' THEN 1 END) AS High,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN severity = 'Medium' THEN 1 END) AS Medium,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN severity = 'Low' THEN 1 END) AS Low
FROM attention

spec.description: The 100 most urgent items with activity in the last 90 days, most severe first and oldest first within a severity; the counts above include every item in that window. WITH

),
project_cicd AS (

),
prod_deploys AS (

  WHERE dc.cicd_scope_id IN (SELECT scope_id FROM scoped_cicd)
