  LEFT JOIN first_progress fp ON fp.issue_id = oi.id
  LEFT JOIN board_med bm ON bm.board_id = oi.board_id
  WHERE oi.is_jira AND CASE WHEN oi.original_status = 'Closed' THEN 'DONE' WHEN oi.original_status IN ('To Do', 'To do', 'Todo') THEN 'TODO' WHEN oi.original_status = 'Ready for Development' THEN 'TODO' WHEN oi.id NOT LIKE 'jira:%' AND oi.status <> 'DONE' THEN CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pull_request_issues pri JOIN pull_requests p2 ON p2.id = pri.pull_request_id AND p2.status = 'OPEN' WHERE pri.issue_id = oi.id) THEN 'IN_PROGRESS' WHEN COALESCE(oi.assignee_id, '') <> '' THEN 'IN_PROGRESS' ELSE 'TODO' END ELSE oi.status END = 'IN_PROGRESS' AND NOT oi.original_status IN ('Blocked', 'Tech Block', 'Business Block')
),
multi_sprint AS (
  SELECT si.issue_id, COUNT(DISTINCT si.sprint_id) AS sprints, MIN(s.started_date) AS first_start
  FROM sprint_issues si
  JOIN sprints s ON s.id = si.sprint_id
  GROUP BY si.issue_id
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT si.sprint_id) >= 2
),
scope_added AS (
  SELECT ic.issue_id, MAX(ic.created_date) AS added_at
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM open_issues WHERE is_jira) oj
  JOIN issue_changelogs ic ON ic.issue_id = oj.id AND ic.field_name = 'Sprint'
  JOIN sprints s ON s.status = 'ACTIVE' AND FIND_IN_SET(s.id, ic.original_to_value) AND NOT FIND_IN_SET(s.id, COALESCE(ic.original_from_value, ''))
  WHERE ic.created_date > s.started_date AND (s.completed_date IS NULL OR ic.created_date < s.completed_date)
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM sprints p
      WHERE FIND_IN_SET(p.id, COALESCE(ic.original_from_value, ''))
        AND p.completed_date BETWEEN ic.created_date - INTERVAL 1 HOUR AND ic.created_date + INTERVAL 1 HOUR)
  GROUP BY ic.issue_id
),
latest_deploy AS (
  SELECT scope_id, env, sha, url, ts, failed, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY scope_id, env ORDER BY ts DESC) AS rn
  FROM prod_deploys
),
att_raw AS (
  SELECT 'High' AS severity, 2 AS severity_rank, 'Unapproved PR' AS category, 2 AS cat_rank, op.item, op.title,
    CONCAT('Open ', FLOOR(op.age_min / 1440), 'd, no approving review') AS reason, FLOOR(op.age_min / 1440) AS age_days,
    op.project_name, op.owner, op.url, CONCAT('pr:', op.id) AS ref, op.last_activity
  FROM open_prs op
  LEFT JOIN repo_med rm ON rm.repo_id = op.repo_id
  WHERE op.age_min > COALESCE(rm.pickup_median, 2 * 1440)
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pull_request_comments c WHERE c.pull_request_id = op.id AND c.status = 'APPROVED')
  UNION ALL
  SELECT CASE WHEN sp.age_min > 30 * 1440 AND sp.last_activity < NOW() - INTERVAL 30 DAY THEN 'Low' ELSE 'High' END,
    CASE WHEN sp.age_min > 30 * 1440 AND sp.last_activity < NOW() - INTERVAL 30 DAY THEN 4 ELSE 2 END,
    'Stale PR', 3, sp.item, sp.title,
    CASE WHEN sp.age_min > 30 * 1440 AND sp.last_activity < NOW() - INTERVAL 30 DAY
      THEN CONCAT('Open ', FLOOR(sp.age_min / 1440), 'd, no activity for ', TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, sp.last_activity, NOW()), 'd')
      ELSE CONCAT('Open ', FLOOR(sp.age_min / 1440), 'd, past twice the repo median to merge') END,
    FLOOR(sp.age_min / 1440), sp.project_name, sp.owner, sp.url, CONCAT('pr:', sp.id), sp.last_activity
  FROM stale_prs sp
  UNION ALL
  SELECT CASE WHEN wr.age_min > 3 * 1440 THEN 'High' ELSE 'Medium' END, CASE WHEN wr.age_min > 3 * 1440 THEN 2 ELSE 3 END,
    'Review waiting', 1, wr.item, wr.title, CONCAT('Open ', FLOOR(wr.age_min / 1440), 'd, requested reviewer has not reviewed'),
    FLOOR(wr.age_min / 1440), wr.project_name, wr.reviewers, wr.url, CONCAT('pr:', wr.id), wr.last_activity
  FROM waiting_reviews wr
  UNION ALL
  SELECT CASE WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, oi.status_since, NOW()) > 7 * 24 THEN 'Critical' ELSE 'High' END,
    CASE WHEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, oi.status_since, NOW()) > 7 * 24 THEN 1 ELSE 2 END,
    'Blocked ticket', 4, oi.issue_key, oi.title,
    CONCAT(oi.original_status, ' for ', GREATEST(TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, oi.status_since, NOW()), 0), 'd'),
    GREATEST(TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, oi.status_since, NOW()), 0), oi.project_name, NULLIF(oi.assignee_name, ''), oi.url, CONCAT('issue:', oi.id), oi.last_activity
  FROM open_issues oi
  WHERE oi.is_jira AND oi.original_status IN ('Blocked', 'Tech Block', 'Business Block')
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'High', 2, 'Stalled ticket', 5, st.issue_key, st.title,
    CONCAT('In progress ', FLOOR(st.days_in_progress), 'd, limit ', FLOOR(st.threshold_days), 'd'),
    FLOOR(st.days_in_progress), st.project_name, NULLIF(st.assignee_name, ''), st.url, CONCAT('issue:', st.id), st.last_activity
  FROM stalled st
  WHERE st.days_in_progress > st.threshold_days
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Medium', 3, 'Not closing', 6, oi.issue_key, oi.title, CONCAT('In ', ms.sprints, ' sprints without closing'),
    GREATEST(TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, ms.first_start, NOW()), 0), oi.project_name, NULLIF(oi.assignee_name, ''), oi.url, CONCAT('issue:', oi.id), oi.last_activity
  FROM open_issues oi
  JOIN multi_sprint ms ON ms.issue_id = oi.id
  WHERE oi.is_jira
  UNION ALL
  SELECT CASE oi.priority WHEN 'Highest' THEN 'Critical' WHEN 'High' THEN 'High' WHEN 'Medium' THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END,
    CASE oi.priority WHEN 'Highest' THEN 1 WHEN 'High' THEN 2 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END,
    'Open bug', 7, oi.issue_key, oi.title,
    CONCAT(COALESCE(NULLIF(oi.priority, ''), 'Unprioritised'), ' bug open ', GREATEST(TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, oi.created_date, NOW()), 0), 'd'),
    GREATEST(TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, oi.created_date, NOW()), 0), oi.project_name, NULLIF(oi.assignee_name, ''), oi.url, CONCAT('issue:', oi.id), oi.last_activity
  FROM open_issues oi
  WHERE (oi.type = 'BUG' OR (oi.id LIKE 'github:%' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM issue_labels il WHERE il.issue_id = oi.id AND il.label_name IN ('bug','Production-Bug'))))
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Medium', 3, 'Unassigned in Ready', 8, oi.issue_key, oi.title,
    CONCAT(oi.original_status, ' for ', GREATEST(TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, oi.status_since, NOW()), 0), 'd, no assignee'),
    GREATEST(TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, oi.status_since, NOW()), 0), oi.project_name, NULL, oi.url, CONCAT('issue:', oi.id), oi.last_activity
  FROM open_issues oi
  WHERE oi.is_jira AND (oi.original_status IN ('Selected for Development', 'Dev Ready', 'Ready for Dev', 'Ready for Development') OR (oi.original_status IN ('To do', 'To Do', 'Todo') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sprint_issues si_r JOIN sprints sp_r ON sp_r.id = si_r.sprint_id WHERE si_r.issue_id = oi.id AND sp_r.status = 'ACTIVE'))) AND COALESCE(oi.assignee_id, '') = ''
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Critical', 1, 'Failed deploy', 9, CONCAT(ld.env, ' · ', LEFT(ld.sha, 7)), CONCAT(cs.name, ' · ', ld.env),
    CONCAT('Latest prod deployment failed ', GREATEST(TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, ld.ts, NOW()), 0), 'd ago, no success since'),
    GREATEST(TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, ld.ts, NOW()), 0), pc.project_name, NULL, ld.url, CONCAT('deploy:', ld.scope_id, ':', ld.env), ld.ts
  FROM latest_deploy ld
  JOIN project_cicd pc ON pc.scope_id = ld.scope_id
  JOIN cicd_scopes cs ON cs.id = ld.scope_id
  WHERE ld.rn = 1 AND ld.failed = 1 AND ld.ts >= NOW() - INTERVAL 90 DAY
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Medium', 3, 'Scope added', 10, oi.issue_key, oi.title, CONCAT('Added to the active sprint ', GREATEST(TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, sa.added_at, NOW()), 0), 'd ago'),
    GREATEST(TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, sa.added_at, NOW()), 0), oi.project_name, NULLIF(oi.assignee_name, ''), oi.url, CONCAT('issue:', oi.id), oi.last_activity
  FROM open_issues oi
  JOIN scope_added sa ON sa.issue_id = oi.id
  WHERE oi.is_jira
),
attention AS (
  SELECT severity, severity_rank, category, item, title, reason, age_days, project_name, owner, url, last_activity
  FROM (
    SELECT ar.severity, ar.severity_rank, ar.category, ar.item, ar.title, ar.reason, ar.age_days, ar.project_name, ar.owner, ar.url, ar.last_activity,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ar.project_name, ar.ref ORDER BY ar.severity_rank, ar.cat_rank) AS pick
    FROM att_raw ar
    
  ) ranked_items
  WHERE pick = 1
)
SELECT /*+ SET_VAR(optimizer_switch='derived_merge=off') */ severity AS Severity, category AS Category, item AS Item, title AS Title, reason AS "Why it is here",
  age_days AS "Age (d)", project_name AS Team, owner AS Owner, url AS url
FROM attention
ORDER BY severity_rank, age_days DESC, item, project_name
LIMIT 100

options.content:
**No targets.** Nothing is compared with a target, because there is nowhere to store an agreed one.

**Grouping and progress.** Progress groups by label, board, milestone or epic; label is the default because every tracker has it. GitHub and GitLab issues are only open or closed, so they count as in progress when a linked pull request is open, otherwise when they have an assignee. Jira uses its own status, and blocked tickets count as in progress.

**Capacity, not ranking.** The contribution table counts effort and gives no score. People are matched by display name, and Verified is Jira only.

**Needs attention** holds ten kinds of item: unapproved PRs, stale PRs, reviews waiting, blocked tickets, stalled tickets, tickets not closing, open bugs, unassigned tickets in Ready, failed production deploys and scope added mid-sprint. A PR is unapproved once it is older than its repository's median time to first review (2 days with no history) and stale once it is older than twice its median time to merge (14 days with no history), from PRs merged in the last 90 days. A review is waiting when a requested reviewer has not commented after 2 days, counted from the PR opening. A ticket is stalled after twice its board's median cycle time (14 days with no history). Blocked means Blocked, Tech Block or Business Block. An item that matches several rules appears once, at its highest severity. This tab leaves out items with no activity in 90 days; the full list has them.

**Severity.** Critical: a failed production deploy, a Highest-priority bug, a ticket blocked over 7 days. High: unapproved or stale PRs, stalled tickets, reviews waiting over 3 days, High-priority bugs. Medium: not closing, scope added, unassigned in Ready, Medium-priority bugs. Low: other bugs, and stale PRs with no activity for 30 days.

**PR cycle time** runs from first commit to merge, not to production, because few PRs are linked to a production deployment. **Tickets done** is the share of tickets created in the last 28 days that are now done.

**AI-assisted** means a merged PR with a commit carrying a Claude co-author trailer or reported by a Claude Code session. It counts AI-assisted work only, with no comparison against unassisted work. **AI spend** is the exporter's estimate, not billed spend.

**Rework rate** is commits authored after a PR's first review comment, over commits on reviewed PRs. **Rollbacks** are production deployments that ship a different commit from the one before and one shipped earlier. **Change failure** is the share of production deployments followed, before the next one, by a merged revert or hotfix PR. **Failed deploy recovery** runs from a failed production deployment to the next success, so it measures recovery from failed deploys, not incidents.

**Type, priority and size** are as recorded in the tracker. PR size is lines added plus deleted.
